title: VIP Green Room | Walk to Broadway
description:
Welcome to the VIP Green Room Off Broadway—your backstage pass to Music City! 🎸 Stay in a one-of-a-kind boutique suite featuring moody emerald walls, vintage vinyl, a Hollywood-style glam room, luxe finishes, and a private balcony.

Easy walk to Nashville's top attractions, including Bridgestone Arena, the Country Music Hall of Fame, Music City Center, Nissan Stadium, Broadway, the Ryman Auditorium, The Gulch and SO MUCH more!

The space
The VIP Green Room Off Broadway is a boutique, music-inspired stay designed for guests who want more than an ordinary Airbnb. Every detail—from the emerald walls and vintage vinyl to the Hollywood-style glam room—was created to capture the energy of Nashville while providing a comfortable, stylish place to relax.

The apartment includes:

🛏️ Private bedroom with a queen bed
🛋️ Cozy semi-private sleeping lounge for additional guests
🍳 Fully equipped kitchen
💄 Hollywood-style glam room for getting ready
🌇 Private balcony
📺 Smart TV & high-speed Wi-Fi
🚿 Modern bathroom

Guests also enjoy access to the building's amenities, including a seasonal resort-style pool and fitness center.

🚗 Reserved garage parking is available for $30/night. Please message us in advance if you'd like to reserve a space.

⏰ Early check-in and late checkout may be available for a small fee, depending on availability.

Whether you're visiting for a concert, girls' trip, couples' getaway, birthday celebration, or game day, The VIP Green Room is the perfect home base for your Nashville adventure.

Other things to note
Reserved parking available for an additional $30/night (optional). Please message us if you'd like to reserve the space.
